gather.labor: as a number, the people dedicated to the task

build.scale: as an integer, the size of the structure
build.name: the name of the building

research.scale: as an integer, the 'size' of the attempted jump in knowledge

found_city.scale: the size of the outpost: 1 being a small forward base, 10 being a large city
found_city.population: the number of people in the city

key_buildings: the main productive buildings in the city

change_empire_name.new_name: the new name of the empire

change_empire_relation.target_empire: the empire whose relation to the player's has changed
change_empire_relation.value: as an integer, the value to increase/decrease by, i.e. 50, or -100, points being from 0 (mortal enemies) to 100 (best of friends/allies)

explore.scale: as an integer, the radius around the origin explored
explore.origin: the place the exploration starts from

custom.catagory: the type of action to the best definition possible at minimum word count
custom.intent: the summarized intent at minimum word count
